$comment: How est builds this plugin (sdk/cpp/build.mjs): each source compiled to wasm32 with clang, linked with EST's flags (the exported, growable table; a 64 KiB stack; est.json's memoryPagesMax as the maximum) into build/module.wasm. est.json is the only file that names the plugin: build/est_plugin.h is written from it before every build.
